newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African rand straddling 4.60, bonds consolidate.
newsitem.headline: S.African rand straddling 4.60, bonds consolidate.

text.p: 0720 GMT - Rand straddling 4.60 after early break through 4.60 level on technical reasons with 4.6050 now seen toppish on the day, forex traders say.
* Early moves seen overdone and no signs of Reserve Bank which conspicuous by its absence for entire week.
* Rand last at 4.5990/6020 on dollar from earlier weakest bid of 4.6030 and 4.5910/5940 late on Wednesday.
* Early trade marked by local commercial bank dollar buying.
* Long bonds trading steady after recent healthy gains, U.S. market aiding positive mood.
* Debt dealers see major consolidation ahead of August 7 options close-out.
* Benchmark R150 last unchanged from Thursday's 1400 GMT level at 14.03 percent. 13.96 to 14.25 percent range seen over next few days.
